summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily ASX disclosures related to its $1 billion share repurchase program. The program authorizes purchases of Class A and Class B common stock on an ongoing basis, with disclosures provided to the ASX per local rules. No specific terms such as price, premium, or timing are stated beyond the aggregate authorization. The filing serves as a procedural update rather than announcing a new program or specific tender. Watch for periodic disclosures of actual repurchase activity and any changes to the program.
